idea-plugin.name: Markdown
idea-plugin.description: Markdown editor support rebuilt from JetBrains/intellij-community sources, adapted for the rebased platform: parser locked to the bundled markdown library, JCEF preview removed, Compose preview enabled by default.

registryKey.description: Shows the Markdown live preview layout.

When true, the Markdown line comment action writes [//]: # (text). When false, it writes <!-- text -->, but a line that contains --> still gets [//]: # (text).
Link which Markdown plugin will use to download PlantUML JAR
Open Markdown link in an external browser (otherwise open in the IDE viewer)
Should Markdown use injected languages' formatters to format code-fences

Determines whether the content security policy should be added to the exported HTML document.

Enables precise scrolling on the document boundaries (direct passing of scroll events from IDE to JCEF preview). Any opened Markdown editors should be manually reopened. Use 'ide.browser.jcef.osr.wheelRotation.factor' to adjust swing's mouse wheel event multiplier.
Enables experimental support for inferring header level
Enables requests for external resources from the preview (e.g. non-local images).
